title: 毛毡蒲公英
style: needle-felted wool miniature, fuzzy mustard fleece, soft sage felt meadow
beats: A tiny wool dandelion sprouts from the orange cheek
The face sniffs and the dandelion sways
A soft sneeze releases six wool seeds
The seeds spiral around the head
Seeds gather back into a fuzzy pompom
The pompom nestles into the orange cheek and the face settles
